## BIA_02 — The iris

| id | speaker | line | direction |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BIA_02_01` | Nela | Welcome to Veyra. I am Nela. Please hold your course. Our guardians will let you through. | Calm |
| `BIA_02_02` | 7 | Oh—hello. |  |
| `BIA_02_03` | Nela | Forgive me. Was that too sudden? | Gentle concern |
| `BIA_02_04` | 7 | A little. Usually there’s a cat attached to that voice. |  |
| `BIA_02_05` | Panther | A considerable improvement, generally. | Composure returning |
| `BIA_02_06` | 7 | That’s the door? |  |
| `BIA_02_07` | Panther | Apparently. |  |
| `BIA_02_08` | 7 | All that ship, and they couldn’t spare a bigger entrance. | Nervous little chuckle |
| `BIA_02_09` | Nela | You have sufficient clearance. Come forward slowly. | Reassuring |
| `BIA_02_10` | Panther | Slowly sounds excellent. |  |
| `BIA_02_11` | 7 | There. Plenty of room. | Releases a breath |
| `BIA_02_12` | Panther | Then you can stop holding yours. | Dry |
| `BIA_02_13` | 7 | Heh. You noticed. |  |
| `BIA_02_14` | Nela | Follow the lights to the receiving berth. Please remain within the marked route. We have an intruder in the inner districts. | Tone becomes serious |

## BIA_03 — A world inside

| id | speaker | line | direction |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BIA_03_01` | 7 | People live all the way up there? |  |
| `BIA_03_02` | Nela | Yes. Most of us never visit every district. |  |
| `BIA_03_03` | 7 | I can believe that. | Breathes out a little laugh |
| `BIA_03_04` | Panther | Remember where we parked. |  |
| `BIA_03_05` | 7 | Little saucer. Enormous wall. Got it. | Quietly amused |
| `BIA_03_06` | 7 | What was that? |  |
| `BIA_03_07` | Nela | A memory from the archive. The damaged relays are carrying it into our shared connection. |  |
| `BIA_03_08` | 7 | The intruder did this? |  |
| `BIA_03_09` | Nela | Yes. Ratwing. He cuts one district off, then moves through it before we can warn the next. |  |
| `BIA_03_10` | Panther | Ratwing? | Suddenly attentive |
| `BIA_03_11` | 7 | You heard that part, then. | A small sideways smile in her voice |
| `BIA_03_12` | Panther | I’m listening to all of it. | Very composed |

## BIA_04 — Something worth stealing

| id | speaker | line | direction |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BIA_04_01` | Nela | He wants the archive. Our histories, discoveries, everything entrusted to it. |  |
| `BIA_04_02` | 7 | To sell? |  |
| `BIA_04_03` | Nela | Or to make us pay for access to our own knowledge. | Quiet anger |
| `BIA_04_04` | 7 | And if we reconnect the districts? |  |
| `BIA_04_05` | Nela | We can coordinate our barriers and keep him from moving freely. |  |
| `BIA_04_06` | Panther | That sounds promising. | Almost too pleased |
| `BIA_04_07` | 7 | You’re enjoying this already. | Under her breath, amused |
| `BIA_04_08` | Panther | I appreciate a well-defined problem. |  |
| `BIA_04_09` | Nela | May I share the way with you? |  |
| `BIA_04_10` | 7 | Would you see my thoughts? | Slight hesitation |
| `BIA_04_11` | Nela | Only what you choose to share. This can go one way. | Patient reassurance |
| `BIA_04_12` | 7 | All right. Just the route. |  |

|---|---|---|---|
